about: The analyst exam: 80 questions, each with its gold answer computed from the data files by tools/savant-mcp/exam/exam.mjs (never typed), its tolerance and the tool calls that reach it. Traps have no gold: the right answer says the data cannot answer, and why (reason). Regenerate: node tools/savant-mcp/exam/exam.mjs gold. Take the exam: RUN.md.
